hints.title: Individual Tower Surface Formula
hints.text: A tower of v cubes contributes 2 + 4 * v surface area when standing in isolation.

hints.title: Adjacent Shared Face Deductions
hints.text: For each adjacent neighbor pair, two faces glue together, reducing exposed surface by twice the minimum height.

hints.title: Grid Traversal Subtraction
hints.text: Add 2 + 4 * v for each cell with v > 0, then subtract 2 * min(v, neighbor) for each top and left neighbor.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Voxel face counting by storing discrete unit cubes consumes excessive memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Accumulate individual column areas and deduct overlapping shared faces.
